hyperedges.label: Shared Chat Component Reuse System (#8a-#8b reused by #9, #10, #11)
i18n bootstrapping pipeline (init first, provide, sync lang)
Dual persistence of user preferences (theme, accent, language)
Web Push Delivery Chain (DB trigger -> Edge Function -> Service Worker)

nodes.label: is_chat_active() helper
nodes.rationale: Blocks calls and message inserts into pending_request or rejected chats.

nodes.label: is_contact() helper
nodes.rationale: Contact is derived, not stored: an active direct chat between the two users, matched via the deterministic direct_pair_key.

nodes.label: profiles_visible view
nodes.rationale: security_invoker=false runs the view as owner bypassing profiles RLS; security_barrier=true prevents optimizer pushdown leaking data; implements column-level privacy that RLS alone cannot do.

nodes.label: create_channel() RPC
nodes.rationale: Validates slug then inserts the channel and auto-follows the owner.

nodes.label: create_community() RPC
nodes.rationale: Inserts community plus owner membership; communities start empty (create_community_chat is Fase 2).

nodes.label: create_direct_chat_request() RPC
nodes.rationale: Creates or reuses a direct chat atomically; rejects self-target and blocked pairs enforces the 7-day cooldown on rejected chats and inserts the initial message.

nodes.label: delete_message_for_everyone() RPC
nodes.rationale: Server-side enforcement of the 1-hour delete-for-everyone window (belt and suspenders with RLS).

nodes.label: handle_chat_member_delete() trigger
nodes.rationale: Last member leaving a group cascade-deletes the chat; last admin leaving auto-promotes the oldest remaining member; direct and self chats are never touched.

nodes.label: handle_community_member_change() triggers
nodes.rationale: Insert increments member_count and auto-joins all community chats; delete decrements and auto-leaves.

nodes.label: handle_message_update() trigger
nodes.rationale: Updates the chat-list preview when the last message is edited or deleted-for-everyone.

nodes.label: handle_new_message() trigger
nodes.rationale: Auto-creates message_receipts for every chat member except the sender (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for idempotency) and updates denormalized last_message_* on chats and channels.

nodes.label: mark_chat_as_read() RPC
nodes.rationale: Updates the caller last_read_at and marks their unread message receipts in the chat atomically.

nodes.label: reject_chat_request() RPC
nodes.rationale: Sets chat status rejected and rejected_at; the chat is not deleted so the sender keeps visibility of the rejection.

nodes.label: block_user action
nodes.rationale: Blocking does NOT delete the chat (WhatsApp parity): it appears under a blocked filter, is excluded from profiles_visible search results and messaging is blocked in both directions by the DB trigger.

nodes.label: check_blocked_on_message_insert() trigger
nodes.rationale: messages_block_check BEFORE INSERT trigger prevents direct messages in either direction between blocked users; runs as SECURITY DEFINER because it needs cross-user reads of chat_members and user_blocks.

nodes.label: calls table
nodes.rationale: chat_id is NOT NULL by design: calls can only happen inside an existing chat, which prevents strangers from calling before the chat request is accepted.

nodes.label: chat_requests table (history only)
nodes.rationale: Keeps historical request and rejection events for the 7-day cooldown; rows are never deleted.

nodes.label: chats table (direct group self community_chat)
nodes.rationale: Single unified chats table instead of separate tables; denormalized last_message_* fields enable fast chat-list rendering without JOIN on messages.

nodes.label: direct_pair_key determinism
nodes.rationale: LEAST/GREATEST canonical ordering of the two user UUIDs guarantees no duplicate 1:1 chats between the same pair regardless of who created the chat.

nodes.label: message_receipts table (per-recipient)
nodes.rationale: Per-recipient rows instead of a boolean on messages enable accurate group read status and per-recipient features.

nodes.label: messages table (chat + channel unified)
nodes.rationale: One messages table for chat and channel messages; chat_id and channel_id are mutually exclusive via CHECK; no channel_messages table.

nodes.label: Fair trade read receipts
nodes.rationale: Bidirectional rule: if a user disables read receipts they cannot see others and others cannot see theirs.

nodes.label: Pending chat request flow
nodes.rationale: Recipient can READ pending messages via a chat_requests JOIN (kept out of chat_members to preserve membership semantics) but cannot INSERT until acceptance; only the creator can send while pending.

nodes.label: Realtime publication (supabase_realtime)
nodes.rationale: Realtime is opt-in per table; chats excluded because every message triggers an UPDATE via denormalization (too chatty); typing indicators via Broadcast deferred to Fase 2.

nodes.label: 7-day rejection cooldown
nodes.rationale: Enforced inside create_direct_chat_request rather than a trigger because it is a business rule not a data-integrity rule; chat_requests rows must never be deleted so the history supports it.

nodes.label: Theme persistence (localStorage + user_settings)
nodes.rationale: Persisted in localStorage for instant pre-login application and server-side in user_settings for cross-device sync; login syncs server to localStorage.

nodes.label: /profile/:username public profile
nodes.rationale: Fetches from profiles_visible so column-level privacy settings automatically apply; Send message calls create_direct_chat_request.

nodes.label: Column-level privacy via view
nodes.rationale: RLS cannot hide individual columns, so privacy-filtered access is done through the profiles_visible view while direct profiles access is restricted to own row.

nodes.label: RPC-only writes for sensitive tables
nodes.rationale: chats, chat_members, chat_requests, channels, communities and community_members have no INSERT policy; writes happen only through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, preventing self-add to foreign groups.

nodes.label: optimizeImage() (client-side WebP compression)
nodes.rationale: Image compression is client-side before upload to match the Prompt #4a storage policy; the server never sees the original

nodes.label: uploadToStorage() (lib/upload.ts)
nodes.rationale: Uses XMLHttpRequest instead of fetch because fetch lacks upload progress support in browsers

nodes.label: VoiceRecorder
nodes.rationale: MediaRecorder with audio/webm;codecs=opus (Safari fallback audio/mp4) detected via isTypeSupported; auto-stop at 5 min

nodes.label: AVATAR_GRADIENTS (from Prompt #6 profile lib)
nodes.rationale: Preset text-story colors reuse the 12 avatar gradient palettes, first 8 shown for simplicity

nodes.label: channel_followers.muted_until column
nodes.rationale: Separate from chat_members.muted_until (different tables, different scope); uses 9999-12-31 for always-muted, consistent with chats

nodes.label: create_story() RPC
nodes.rationale: 10-active-stories limit enforced in the RPC not RLS because it needs a COUNT query and a clearer error; 15s video cut enforced client-side AND server-side (client gives UX, server gives safety)

nodes.label: mark_story_viewed() RPC
nodes.rationale: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes viewing idempotent - opening a story twice does not double-count

nodes.label: StoryReplyInput
nodes.rationale: Story reply goes through create_direct_chat_request first to ensure the chat exists and handle block/cooldown

nodes.label: StoryViewer
nodes.rationale: Story reply opens a mini-composer; submitting creates/reuses the direct chat and sends a DM with reply_to_story_id set

nodes.label: useStoryTimer()
nodes.rationale: Uses requestAnimationFrame not setInterval to avoid timer drift during long stories

nodes.label: Broadcast Channels System
nodes.rationale: Channel messages reuse the messages table with channel_id set (mutually exclusive with chat_id via CHECK); channels have no reply action - topology is 1-to-many broadcast, not conversational

nodes.label: Stories System (24h ephemeral)
nodes.rationale: Stories are hard-deleted (no soft delete) by owner action or cron job; max 10 active per user; viewer is a modal not a route because the modal is more fluid for the swipe-down-to-close gesture

nodes.label: Migration 0014_push_triggers.sql
nodes.rationale: Requires pg_net extension and ALTER DATABASE app.settings.supabase_url / service_role_key because triggers cannot read env vars.

nodes.label: notify_new_message trigger
nodes.rationale: pg_net trigger chosen over Database Webhooks because webhooks cannot JOIN chat_members to fan out to all recipients.

nodes.label: sw-custom.js push handler
nodes.rationale: importScripts approach chosen over strategies:'injectManifest' for MVP simplicity (no custom SW build step).

nodes.label: .env.example (all vars)
nodes.rationale: Documents the VITE_ (public) vs server-side secret split: LiveKit/VAPID/Turnstile/Sentry secrets never reach the browser.

nodes.label: src/lib/sentry.ts (initSentry)
nodes.rationale: beforeSend filters errors from browser extensions and URLs containing access_token/refresh_token (magic link callbacks must never reach Sentry); ignoreErrors drops offline noise like 'Failed to fetch'.

nodes.label: Web Push (VAPID)
nodes.rationale: Public key must be exposed to browser (VITE_ prefix) for subscribe(); private key never sent to client, kept as Supabase secret.

nodes.label: Deployment & Metadata (Prompt 16)
nodes.rationale: Final prompt of the 16-section roadmap; adds no user-facing feature, makes the app production-ready. No analytics in MVP, *.netlify.app subdomain, manual pg_dump backups, migrations stay manual.

nodes.label: Sentry Error Tracking (free tier)
nodes.rationale: Replay masks all text and blocks all media (privacy-first, no user content captured); tracesSampleRate 0.1 and 5% session replay to stay within the 5k events/month free tier. Backend Sentry integration deferred to Fase 2.

nodes.label: docs/FASE-2.md (deferred features)
nodes.rationale: Catalogues every deferred item across all 16 prompts so nothing is lost silently - prevents scope creep.

nodes.label: Manual pg_dump Backup Policy
nodes.rationale: Documented (not scripted) so the developer thinks before restoring; keep last 3 dumps; automated backups require Supabase Pro.

nodes.label: Source maps never served publicly
nodes.rationale: Generated at build and uploaded to Sentry only; safe despite sourcemap:true because browsers never receive them.

nodes.label: handle_new_user() trigger
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER; inserts a profile with placeholder username user_xxxxxxxx plus default user_settings; onboarding forces a real username.

nodes.label: get_my_storage_usage() RPC
nodes.rationale: Returns SUM(size_bytes) of the user completed uploads for the settings storage screen.

nodes.label: 60s session heartbeat (presence)
nodes.rationale: Client-side interval updates profiles.last_seen_at every 60s; no Supabase Presence and no custom RPC needed since profiles RLS allows own-row update.

nodes.label: Deterministic avatar gradient (SHA-256)
nodes.rationale: SHA-256 hash of user_id modulo 12 fixed gradient palettes; no DB column, consistent across devices and immune to cache clears.

nodes.label: cleanup-deleted-accounts scheduled function
nodes.rationale: Daily Netlify Scheduled Function hard-deletes expired accounts via auth.admin.deleteUser whose cascade handles profiles and message sender_id nullification per the #4a foreign keys.

nodes.label: Device fingerprint (localStorage UUID)
nodes.rationale: crypto.randomUUID persisted in localStorage and sent to BFF on login; column is nullable because browsers with strict fingerprinting protection may clear localStorage.

nodes.label: avatar upload optimization flow
nodes.rationale: Client-side WebP compression to 512x512 quality 0.85 before upload per the #4a section 6.2 mandate; file_uploads row written before upload with status pending then completed.

nodes.label: validate_username_change() trigger
nodes.rationale: Cooldown enforced by the DB not the app so it cannot be bypassed; also rejects the placeholder username pattern as a change target.

nodes.label: file_uploads table (metadata decoupled from bucket)
nodes.rationale: Metadata separated from storage buckets enables provider migration (Supabase to R2/B2/S3) without data loss, per-user quotas and analytics.

nodes.label: Storage buckets (avatars, chat-media, story-media, channel-media)
nodes.rationale: All buckets private; avatars private because photo visibility is a user setting enforced by RLS with signed URLs for retrieval.

nodes.label: Storage bucket policies (storage.objects)
nodes.rationale: First path segment via storage.foldername is always the scope ID; delete checks route through the file_uploads table.

nodes.label: pg_cron cleanup jobs
nodes.rationale: Cron jobs clean DB rows but not actual storage files; orphan Storage files accumulate on free tier and Edge Function cleanup is documented as Fase 2.

nodes.label: 30-day account deletion grace period
nodes.rationale: MVP grace period with a globally visible banner and cancel button; actual deletion is a cascade from auth.users.

nodes.label: create_community() RPC (auto-creates General chat)
nodes.rationale: Rewritten instead of extended for atomicity: community + membership + General chat + owner chat membership in one transaction

nodes.label: handle_community_member_delete() trigger (succession)
nodes.rationale: Handles normal owner departure as well as deletion: succession orders by CASE role='admin' first, then joined_at ASC (oldest admin, else oldest member)

nodes.label: handle_profile_deletion_community_succession() trigger
nodes.rationale: Fires BEFORE DELETE ON profiles so succession runs before the FK sets owner_id = NULL

nodes.label: mute_community() RPC (bulk)
nodes.rationale: Community-level mute updates all chat_members.muted_until rows in bulk; per-chat mute still allowed individually

nodes.label: Community Ownership Succession
nodes.rationale: If owner leaves: promote oldest admin; if no admins promote oldest member and make admin; if no members left delete the community; must also handle account deletion cascade

nodes.label: iOS push requires install (16.4+)
nodes.rationale: iOS Safari fires no beforeinstallprompt; Web Push only works for installed PWA on iOS 16.4+, cannot be bypassed.

nodes.label: OKLCH palette (locked design constants)
nodes.rationale: Every OKLCH value is a validated constant used verbatim; they must not be rounded or adjusted.

nodes.label: @theme inline Tailwind bridge
nodes.rationale: The inline modifier is required because all referenced values are dynamic CSS variables; without it Tailwind resolves at build time and theme switching breaks.

nodes.label: Dark mode three-rule system
nodes.rationale: prefers-color-scheme block guarded by :not([data-theme=light]) so Rule 2 and Rule 3 never double fire; explicit dark override wins via attribute-selector specificity.

nodes.label: vite-plugin-pwa config (Workbox)
nodes.rationale: registerType 'prompt', SW disabled in dev (devOptions.enabled:false) to avoid cache hell; runtimeCaching splits avatars (StaleWhileRevalidate), chat media & API (NetworkOnly).

nodes.label: PWA & Offline Support
nodes.rationale: vite-plugin-pwa + Workbox, IndexedDB offline cache, outbox for text messages, VAPID push in MVP; Background Sync deliberately not used (P9) - outbox only processes while the tab is open.

nodes.label: Workbox Cache Strategies
nodes.rationale: NetworkOnly for chat media because signed URLs expire in 5 minutes; caching would break and expose media.

nodes.label: usePrivacySettings hook
nodes.rationale: Single update mutation for all privacy fields to avoid race conditions when two toggles fire quickly.

nodes.label: Fair-trade Read Receipts
nodes.rationale: Read receipts are bidirectional (fair-trade); disabling shows a warning modal before the mutation because the trade-off is important enough to confirm. Re-enabling needs no warning.

nodes.label: CSS-first Tailwind config (@theme)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 needs no tailwind.config.js; design tokens live in src/styles/globals.css under @theme; plugin registration via @plugin and @tailwindcss/vite.

nodes.label: Three-layer token cascade
nodes.rationale: Accent layer (4 tokens) overrides cascade into semantic then component layers, so switching an accent theme redefines only 4 tokens and everything downstream adapts.

nodes.label: Accent color system (6 themes)
nodes.rationale: blue/purple/red/orange/yellow/green applied via <html class='theme-{accent}'>; default blue; oklch swatches shown in AppearanceScreen

nodes.label: Dual persistence (localStorage + user_settings)
nodes.rationale: Theme, accent, and language are written both to localStorage and user_settings; localStorage wrapped in try/catch because Safari private mode throws; after login the user_settings fetch overrides localStorage for cross-device sync

nodes.label: Intl-only locale formatters
nodes.rationale: Use only native Intl APIs — no date libraries (moment/date-fns/dayjs forbidden); Intl.RelativeTimeFormat with numeric:'auto' yields 'yesterday' instead of '1 day ago' intentionally

nodes.label: Language detection priority chain
nodes.rationale: localStorage → navigator.language → user_settings (when logged in, overrides — cross-device sync is the source of truth once authenticated) → fallback en; convertDetectedLanguage normalizes es-MX/es-AR/en-US to es/en

nodes.label: Locale namespace system (9 namespaces)
nodes.rationale: Nested structure + 9 namespaces (common, auth, chats, messages, calls, communities, novedades, settings, errors) split so resources can be lazy-loaded per namespace; en is default/fallback, es supported

nodes.label: prefers-color-scheme runtime listener
nodes.rationale: matchMedia change listener runs ONLY when theme==='system' so it never overrides an explicit user choice

nodes.label: Theme preference system (light/dark/system)
nodes.rationale: data-theme='dark' attribute is only set for explicit dark because light is the default :root — the CSS from Prompt #3 relies on this; two dimensions kept separate: mode (attribute) × accent (class)

nodes.label: user_settings table (shared preferences store)
nodes.rationale: Columns theme, accent, language already exist (schema must NOT be changed in this prompt); defaults per user_settings default in #4a: theme=system, accent=blue, language=en

nodes.label: FOUC prevention (inline blocking script)
nodes.rationale: The script must be inline and blocking: it must run before CSS paints; a deferred script would still flash the wrong theme

nodes.label: CI-gated Netlify deploy
nodes.rationale: Netlify Git integration with 'Wait for CI' chosen over deploy hooks (simpler); migrations stay manual to prevent accidental DROP TABLE on prod.

nodes.label: Security Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
nodes.rationale: CSP must allowlist Cloudflare Turnstile, Supabase, LiveKit, Sentry; frame-ancestors 'none' plus X-Frame-Options DENY is belt-and-suspenders for older browsers.

nodes.label: SPA-not-SSR decision
nodes.rationale: SSR conflicts with PWA offline caching; SEO is irrelevant for chat content; all major web messengers are SPAs; TanStack Start still evolving.

nodes.label: Presence via Polling (not Realtime)
nodes.rationale: profiles RLS only lets users see their own row, so realtime broadcasts of last_seen_at never reach other users; MVP polls profiles_visible every 30s (direct) / 60s (group), dedicated presence service deferred to Fase 2

nodes.label: add_chat_members() bulk RPC
nodes.rationale: Silently skips blocked users instead of throwing - avoids leaking block status to the adder

nodes.label: ContactProfileModal
nodes.rationale: Modal only reachable from a chat, not from search or chat list; hides last_seen_at when presence_visible=false (profiles_visible already NULLs it)

nodes.label: demote_chat_admin() RPC
nodes.rationale: Admin checks live on the server because a malicious user could call the RPC directly regardless of what the client UI hides; creator cannot be demoted by others to prevent hostile group takeovers

nodes.label: directPairKey() (LEAST/GREATEST pair key)
nodes.rationale: Must use LEAST/GREATEST to match the DB computed direct_pair_key column from Prompt #4a

nodes.label: GroupSettingsScreen (/chats/$chatId/info)
nodes.rationale: Route instead of modal because it is reachable outside the chat (notifications, chat list context menu) - Fase 2

nodes.label: MuteSubmenu
nodes.rationale: 'Always' uses muted_until = 9999-12-31 instead of NULL because NULL means not-muted in the schema

nodes.label: useUIStore (Zustand modal state)
nodes.rationale: Transient modals in a Zustand store are simpler than URL state

nodes.label: ChannelHeader
nodes.rationale: Deliberately NOT the ChatHeader - shows follower count, verified badge, follow/unfollow instead of call buttons because channels are not chats

nodes.label: CommunityChatSidebar (desktop two-pane)
nodes.rationale: Two-pane desktop layout uses a layout route rather than each chat route rendering the sidebar to avoid re-mount on chat navigation

nodes.label: Communities System (Prompt #11)
nodes.rationale: Invite-only, no discovery in MVP; community chats are chats.type='community_chat' with community_id set and membership derived from community_members via triggers from #4b-2

nodes.label: public/robots.txt
nodes.rationale: App routes are disallowed - it is an auth-only app and indexing chat URLs is pointless; blocking avoids bots hammering routes that would 401 anyway.

nodes.label: App-wide accessibility rules
nodes.rationale: WCAG AA contrast minimums; color never the sole state indicator (color + icon or text); 44x44 touch targets; aria-labels on icon-only buttons; visible focus ring.

nodes.label: app_config table (runtime config + feature flags)
nodes.rationale: Dynamic JSONB values let upload limits and feature flags change without redeploy or migration.

nodes.label: AAL2 refresh-token rotation workaround
nodes.rationale: Supabase does not expose a clean way to rotate cookies after MFA from a SPA; MVP calls POST /api/auth/refresh after mfa.verify to store the new session; dedicated /api/auth/mfa-complete endpoint documented as Fase 2.

nodes.label: linkify-react (safe URL linking dependency)
nodes.rationale: Linkify sets rel='noopener noreferrer nofollow' to prevent window.opener exploits and SEO leaking

nodes.label: livekit-token Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Uses service-role client to bypass RLS for the atomic call lookup; validates call active, <5 min old, caller is chat member; issues LiveKit AccessToken with 15-minute TTL.

nodes.label: start_call RPC
nodes.rationale: Atomic SECURITY DEFINER RPC: validates membership via is_chat_member, chat active via is_chat_active, direct/self chats only, no concurrent calls, generates room name 'call_{uuid}'.

nodes.label: useIncomingCall hook
nodes.rationale: Realtime INSERT subscription on calls (status ringing, <15s) plus belt-and-suspenders DB poll on mount to catch events missed during brief disconnects.

nodes.label: useLiveKitRoom hook
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates entire LiveKit lifecycle; audio levels via LiveKit's built-in audioLevelChanged analyser instead of setInterval (less CPU); setCameraEnabled called after setMicrophoneEnabled to avoid publish-order issues on Safari.

nodes.label: netlify/functions/health.ts (/api/health)
nodes.rationale: Returns 503 on degraded status because uptime monitors need non-200 to trigger alerts.

nodes.label: /health SPA route
nodes.rationale: Public route (not under _authenticated) so uptime monitors can reach it; kept for human debugging alongside the /api/health function which returns proper 200/503 codes.

nodes.label: Busy Auto-Reject
nodes.rationale: Incoming call while user is already in a call is immediately marked missed with reason 'busy', never shown to the user.

nodes.label: Call State Machine
nodes.rationale: Locked transitions: ringing -> answered -> ended / missed / declined / canceled; frontend marks missed at 15s, backend cron at 20s (network tolerance - client is more accurate when alive).

nodes.label: Peer Disconnect Detection (3s grace)
nodes.rationale: Waits 3s after participantDisconnected before ending the call so brief reconnects keep the call alive; room.disconnect() happens before the DB UPDATE to guarantee no orphaned media streams.

nodes.label: Remote Audio Level Waveform
nodes.rationale: Uses LiveKit audioLevelChanged events (built-in analyser) updating callStore.remoteAudioLevel 0-100; CSS-only pulse ring preferred for cheapness and smoothness across devices.

nodes.label: Voice & Video Calls Feature (LiveKit)
nodes.rationale: Last major roadmap feature; 1:1 calls only in MVP, LiveKit Cloud free tier (10k min/mo, 100 concurrent). Group calls, recording, screen sharing explicitly deferred to Fase 2.

nodes.label: Permissions Before LiveKit Connect
nodes.rationale: getUserMedia is requested BEFORE calling the Edge Function so denied-permission failures do not waste LiveKit tokens; no complex retry flow in MVP.

nodes.label: Ring Timeout (15s frontend / 20s cron)
nodes.rationale: Frontend marks missed at 15s, backend cron only after 20s to account for network latency; client is authoritative when connected.

nodes.label: formatChatTimestamp
nodes.rationale: Intl.RelativeTimeFormat needs numeric:'auto' to give localized 'yesterday' instead of '1 day ago'

nodes.label: MentionAutocomplete
nodes.rationale: Mentions autocomplete only triggers in group and community_chat - has no purpose in 1:1 direct chats

nodes.label: MessageBubble
nodes.rationale: All bubbles are rounded-2xl with no tails - grouping communicated via vertical spacing and avatar presence, no corner-radius logic

nodes.label: MessageList
nodes.rationale: No virtualization in MVP - plain scroll container handles 50-500 messages; scroll position preserved on prepend via requestAnimationFrame

nodes.label: useRealtimeMessages()
nodes.rationale: Realtime INSERT is skipped when payload matches own optimistic message (temp- prefix check) to prevent double-render

nodes.label: ReplyPreview (bar above composer + quoted bubble)
nodes.rationale: reply-to uses the reply_to:messages!reply_to_message_id join - single round-trip, no N+1 for quoted messages

nodes.label: ChannelView (/channels/:channelId)
nodes.rationale: Reuses MessageList with a channelMode prop to avoid duplicating pagination/scroll logic

nodes.label: Drafts System (silverchat_draft_{chat_id})
nodes.rationale: Drafts are read synchronously from localStorage on render so they are visible without a network call; user-local-only in MVP

nodes.label: Optimistic UI Pipeline (pending > sent > delivered > read)
nodes.norm_label: optimistic ui pipeline (pending > sent > delivered > read)
nodes.rationale: Optimistic message IDs use temp- prefix to avoid collision with real UUIDs and to easily identify server messages echoed back

nodes.label: /api/auth/backup-code-verify endpoint
nodes.rationale: Server-side constant-time comparison of hashed backup codes; on success removes all MFA factors forcing re-enrollment because the TOTP device is presumed lost.

nodes.label: AuthProvider context
nodes.rationale: On mount calls /api/auth/refresh; hydrates user; routes redirect to /auth/2fa-verify when mfaRequired; auto-refresh interval every 50 minutes.

nodes.label: /api/auth/refresh endpoint
nodes.rationale: Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and rotates the refresh cookie (Supabase rotates on refresh).

nodes.label: src/lib/auth.ts token manager
nodes.rationale: Access token in memory with deduplicated concurrent refreshes via a shared refreshPromise.

nodes.label: _authenticated protected route layout
nodes.rationale: beforeLoad redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login with redirect param preservation; mfaRequired redirects to /auth/2fa-verify; full-screen skeleton while hydrating because skeleton feels faster than a spinner.

nodes.label: supabase.ts custom fetch (Bearer injection)
nodes.rationale: persistSession false and autoRefreshToken false are mandatory; otherwise the SDK writes tokens to localStorage defeating the BFF and two refresh mechanisms compete. Custom fetch injects the Bearer header and retries once on 401.

nodes.label: Magic link authentication
nodes.rationale: Passwordless by design; Resend must be connected because Supabase built-in SMTP is rate-limited and lands in spam.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: Single mental model: rows are invisible unless a policy grants access; this is what makes exposing the Supabase anon key to the browser safe.

nodes.label: VITE_ env prefix safety
nodes.rationale: Only browser-safe variables exposed; the anon key is safe only because RLS is enabled; service-role and API secrets live in Edge Function env vars.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Turnstile captcha
nodes.rationale: Captcha on signup only; login is protected by the Supabase 30 emails per hour rate limit which is deemed sufficient.

nodes.label: httpOnly cookie session model
nodes.rationale: Refresh token in an HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookie immune to XSS exfiltration; access token held in JS memory only so XSS theft is limited to 1h; CSRF handled by SameSite plus Origin verification.

nodes.label: 2FA: TOTP + 10 backup codes
nodes.rationale: Settings-only (not offered in onboarding); backup codes are SHA-256 hashed client-side before insert (defense against DB leak) and compared server-side (client cannot be trusted for auth decisions).

nodes.label: two_factor_backup_codes table
nodes.rationale: Marking codes used and regeneration happen via service role (BFF) only; no client UPDATE or DELETE policies.

nodes.label: Privacy-first philosophy
nodes.rationale: Privacy is guaranteed in the database layer, not the frontend; data must be exportable with no vendor lock-in.

nodes.label: 0-to-10k scaling strategy
nodes.rationale: Scaling must mean changing the billing plan, not rewriting the backend; pg_dump gives a complete restorable export; frontend must be portable (Netlify to Cloudflare Pages).

nodes.label: BFF architecture (Netlify Functions)
nodes.rationale: SPAs cannot set httpOnly cookies from client-side JS, so a thin serverless layer handles only cookie-related auth ops; the client queries Supabase directly with a Bearer token and RLS still enforces security.

nodes.label: delete_self_chat() RPC
nodes.rationale: Dedicated RPC instead of chat_members DELETE because removing a membership row would orphan a self-chat with no members

nodes.label: useChats()
nodes.rationale: LIMIT 200 applied despite the 'load all at once' decision as safety against pathological cases; realtime invalidates via query key rather than patching state (simpler, avoids stale merged state bugs)

nodes.label: useMarkAsRead()
nodes.rationale: Read receipts have 1s delay on initial load vs 500ms for subsequent messages at bottom - initial feels more deliberate, subsequent is snappier

nodes.label: Message Requests Flow (accept/decline, 7-day retry block)
nodes.rationale: Rejected requests silently disappear the chat from the sender's list and block retries for 7 days (anti-spam cooldown)

nodes.label: Migration 0007: Chat Delete Adjustments
nodes.rationale: manually_unread is a boolean column instead of relying on last_read_at IS NULL because mark_chat_as_read sets receipts read_at=now(), so clearing last_read_at would not resurrect the unread count; a boolean is unambiguous

nodes.label: Message Forwarding (max 5 chats)
nodes.rationale: file_upload_id is copied on forward so the same storage object is reused with no re-upload; the file_uploads row's uploader_id stays the original sender

nodes.label: offline-db.ts (IndexedDB schema)
nodes.rationale: Messages store uses compound key [user_id, chat_id] so multiple accounts on one device never leak data; clearAllUserData runs on logout for the same privacy guarantee.

nodes.label: usePushSubscription hook
nodes.rationale: Stores Web Push subscription into devices.push_subscription jsonb (from #4a), keyed with getOrCreateDeviceFingerprint(); permission prompt must follow a user gesture.

nodes.label: auth-logout-all Netlify Function
nodes.rationale: Uses supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.signOut(userId, 'others'), not 'global', to keep the current session alive while invalidating all other refresh tokens.

nodes.label: SecuritySummaryCard component
nodes.rationale: Read-only informational card (2FA, backup codes, email verified, active devices) - actions live in their respective screens, the card only surfaces state; 'email verified' always true in MVP because magic-link auth verifies the email.

nodes.label: Sign out all other devices flow
nodes.norm_label: sign out all other devices flow

nodes.label: IndexedDB Offline Cache (50/chat + 200 chats)
nodes.rationale: Per-user isolation via compound keys; cache is cleared on logout so the next user on the device cannot see cached data.

nodes.label: Device Fingerprint
nodes.rationale: getOrCreateDeviceFingerprint() called inline - the fingerprint never changes for a given browser, so no state storage needed.

nodes.label: Devices Table (active devices / push subscriptions)
nodes.rationale: Active devices counted as rows with last_active_at within 30 days; push_subscription jsonb column added in #4a is shared between settings UI and push subscription.

nodes.label: Privacy & Security Wiring Pass
nodes.rationale: Pure wiring pass: no new migrations or RPCs; connects UI screens (#5/#6) to backend from #4a/#4b-1/#4b-2. App lock / PIN / biometrics / passkeys and per-device sign-out explicitly NOT PLANNED (not even Fase 2).

nodes.label: IndexedDB cleared on logout
nodes.rationale: clearAllUserData(userId) called before session teardown so no cross-user data leaks on a shared device.

nodes.label: Outbox without Background Sync
nodes.rationale: Outbox processes only on online transition or visibilitychange while the tab is open; no Background Sync API in MVP.

nodes.label: check_pin_limit() trigger (max 3 pinned)
nodes.rationale: Pin limit is a DB trigger and not app validation because two users pinning simultaneously would race past a client-side check

nodes.label: actionMatrix.getAvailableActions()
nodes.rationale: Pure exported function - testable, cacheable, no React state dependency; edit allowed within 15 min on text/image/video, delete-for-everyone within 1h

nodes.label: InChatSearch (local-only search)
nodes.rationale: Search is local-only over loaded messages with a persistent note that old messages are missed; 2s highlight fades via CSS animation

nodes.label: useAudioStore (Zustand exclusive playback)
nodes.rationale: Uses direct store access (.getState()) in event handlers instead of hooks to avoid re-renders during playback

nodes.label: clear_chat_for_me() RPC
nodes.rationale: Soft action: no message is deleted from the DB, only from the user's view via message_deletions - other members still see them

nodes.label: CommunityChatHeader
nodes.rationale: No call/video buttons: community chats do not start calls directly; calls are 1:1 only in MVP

nodes.label: Delete For Me / Delete For Everyone
nodes.norm_label: delete for me / delete for everyone
nodes.rationale: delete-for-everyone optimistically replaces content with a placeholder instead of removing the row - preserves scroll position and other users still see it

nodes.label: Edit Message (15-min window)
nodes.rationale: RLS from Prompt #4b-1 enforces the 15-minute edit window server-side; the UI hides the option earlier via the action matrix

nodes.label: Static SVG Waveform Decision (vs wavesurfer.js)
nodes.rationale: Static SVG from media_peaks (0 extra KB) preferred over wavesurfer.js (50KB gzipped) for a simple waveform + progress bar; wavesurfer kept only for Fase 2 features like region selection

hyperedges.label: Shared Chat Component Reuse System (#8a-#8b reused by #9, #10, #11)
i18n bootstrapping pipeline (init first, provide, sync lang)
Dual persistence of user preferences (theme, accent, language)
Web Push Delivery Chain (DB trigger -> Edge Function -> Service Worker)
